DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のご相談ですね。これから新しく振り込みたいのか、前のお手続きを確認したいのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to discuss a transfer. Is this a new transfer or a check on an earlier procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃です。昨日操作したのに相手から届いていないと言われ、もう一度振り込もうと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日家賃振込の操作をしたが未着と言われ、もう一度振り込みに来たと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is rent. I operated the transfer yesterday, but the recipient says it has not arrived, so I came intending to transfer it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you operated a rent transfer yesterday, were told it had not arrived, and came to transfer again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 重ねて手続きをする前に、昨日の記録を確認しましょう。完了を示す画面や受付の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before repeating the procedure, let us check yesterday's record. Do you have a completion screen or acceptance record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面に「予約受付」とあります。終わったと思っていましたが、実行されたかどうかまでは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面は予約受付で、実行済みかはまだ見ていないと記録を示す。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This screen says 'Scheduled transfer accepted.' I thought it was finished, but have not checked whether it was executed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the record saying scheduled transfer accepted and explain you have not checked execution yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約の受付と、振込の実行は分けて確認が必要です。予定日や受付番号は、担当に見てもらいましょう。受取先の案内もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Acceptance of a scheduled transfer and execution must be checked separately. Let the staff see the scheduled date and reference number. Do you also have the recipient instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この請求書です。口座番号だけでなく受取人名と金額も照合し、二重に払わないよう先の分を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求書を示し、受取名・番号・金額を照合して二重払いを避けるため先の取引を確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, this invoice. I want to match not only the account number but also the recipient name and amount, and check the earlier transaction to avoid paying twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the invoice and request matching recipient name, number, and amount and checking the earlier transaction to avoid duplicate payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。確認が済むまでは、新しい振込を実行しないでください。手数料についても不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request on. Do not execute a new transfer until the check is complete. Are there any questions about fees?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の分の手数料も記録で見たいです。追加の手数料を払えば早く届く、とは決めつけず、まず予約の状態を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前の分の手数料も確認したく、追加手数料で早着を図ると決めず予約状態から聞くと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also want to see yesterday's fee in the record. I will not assume an extra fee makes it arrive faster; first I will ask about the scheduled transfer's status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the earlier fee and will first ask the schedule's status without assuming an extra fee speeds arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約の状態、受取先と金額、手数料の三点ですね。請求先へは、確認中であることを伝える方法も考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Three points: schedule status, recipient and amount, and fees. You could also tell the party billing you that you are checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三点を紙で担当へ伝えます。相手には予約を調べていると連絡し、実行済みか不明のまま二度目の振込はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約状態・受取先と金額・手数料を担当へ渡し、相手へ確認中と連絡して不明なまま二度目を実行しないと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give those three points to the staff on paper. I will tell the recipient I am checking the schedule and will not send a second transfer while execution is unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give staff schedule status, recipient and amount, and fees; say you will notify the recipient of the check and not transfer again while execution is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい送金ではなく、昨日の予約状況の照会としてお受けしました。この記録と請求書を持って担当席へどうぞ。確認事項も引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received this as an inquiry into yesterday's scheduled transfer, not a new remittance. Take this record and invoice to the staff desk. I will pass on the points to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はこちらです。かごの物は、まとめてのお支払いでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please pay here. Would you like everything in the basket on one bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食品は同居人と共同ですが、このシャンプーは私だけの物です。支払う前に二つの会計へ分けられるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同購入の食品と私物シャンプーを分け、支払前に二会計へできるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The food is shared with my housemate, but this shampoo is mine alone. Before paying, I want to ask whether you can split them into two bills.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Separate shared food from personal shampoo and ask before paying whether two bills are possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このレジでは分けて進められます。先に共同の食品、その後にシャンプーでよろしいですか。袋のご希望も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can separate them at this register. Shared food first, then shampoo, correct? Please also tell me your bag preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その順でお願いします。食品は持参した袋へ入れますが、シャンプー用の袋は忘れました。一枚買う場合の価格を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品を先に私物を後にすると答え、持参袋は食品用なので私物用の購入袋一枚の価格を聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That order, please. I will put the food in my own bag, but forgot one for the shampoo. I want to know the price of buying one bag first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Agree to food first and personal items second, explain your own bag is for food, and ask the price of one bag for the personal item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋はこちらの表示の価格です。シャンプーの会計へ加えられます。食品のほうは、どの方法でお支払いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bag price is displayed here. We can add it to the shampoo bill. How will you pay for the food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 共同の現金から払います。シャンプーと袋は自分のカードを使いたいので、後の会計で対応するか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共同食品は現金、私物と袋は自分のカードと希望し後会計の対応確認を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: With our shared cash. I want to use my own card for the shampoo and bag, so please check whether it is accepted for the second bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request cash for shared food and your own card for the shampoo and bag, and ask to check card acceptance for the later bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現金で食品のお支払いを進めます。次の会計ではカードの対応表示を確認します。まず、この食品の一覧と合計をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take cash for the food and check the card acceptance display for the next bill. First look at this food list and total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食品の一覧にシャンプーは入っていませんね。合計を確認して現金で払い、共同分のレシートは一枚目として分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食品一覧に私物が混ざらないことと合計を確認し現金払い後に一枚目の共同レシートを分けると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The shampoo is not on the food list, correct? I will check the total, pay cash, and keep the first receipt separately for the shared items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that personal items are absent from the food list and verify the total, then say you will pay cash and separate the first shared receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食品のお支払いを受け取りました。こちらが一枚目のレシートです。続いてシャンプーと袋一枚です。このカードは対応していますので、次の合計をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Food payment received. Here is the first receipt. Next is shampoo and one bag. This card is accepted, so please check the next total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つ目はシャンプーと袋一枚ですね。この合計をカードで払い、二枚目のレシートを自分用にして、袋も食品とは別にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つ目のシャンプーと袋の合計をカード払いし、二枚目を自分用レシートとし袋も食品と別にすると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The second bill is shampoo and one bag. I will pay this total by card, use the second receipt as my personal one, and keep the bag separate from the food too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pay the shampoo-and-bag total by card, keep the second receipt for yourself, and keep that bag separate from food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つのお会計が済みました。食品のレシートと、ご自身の物のレシートを分けてお渡ししました。商品と袋をお確かめになり、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Both payments are complete. I have given you separate receipts for food and personal items. Check your purchases and bags, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カートとご一緒の散歩ですね。案内図のどの道をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are walking with a cart. Which route are you looking at on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口から池までの道に階段がないようなので、そのまま一周して戻ろうと思いました。荷物があるので短く歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カートを引き荷物があるので短く歩きたいが、入口から池の無階段区間を見て一周できると思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The path from the entrance to the pond seems to have no stairs, so I thought I could complete the circuit and return. I have luggage, so want a short walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are pulling a cart with luggage and want a short walk, but thought a circuit possible after seeing the stair-free entrance-to-pond section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行きの線だけではなく、戻る区間も見ましょう。この一周の帰りには階段の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Look at the return section as well as the outward line. The return part of this circuit has a stair symbol.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池まで行けても、その先を回ると階段になるのですね。カートを持ち上げて戻ることは避けたいので、一周はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池の先の帰路は階段と理解し、カートを持上げるのを避け一周をやめると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even if I reach the pond, going around farther leads to stairs. I do not want to lift the cart to return, so I will give up the circuit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the return beyond the pond has stairs and decide against the circuit to avoid lifting the cart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 池の手前で来た道を戻る短い往復も考えられます。ただし路面の状態は歩く場所でお確かめください。途中で休みたいご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could make a short out-and-back, turning before the pond. However, check the actual surface where you walk. Would you like to rest along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。池まで行くことにこだわらず、途中で休んで戻れる範囲にします。座る場所の近くでカートを置ける余地も見て決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 池へ行くことに固執せず休んで戻れる範囲にし、座席付近のカート置場の余地も見たいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not insist on reaching the pond, only go far enough to rest and return. I also want to check space for the cart near a seat before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not insist on the pond, stay within a distance allowing rest and return, and check cart space near seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図の休憩表示はこちらです。席や周囲の空きは保証できませんので、通路を塞がず置けるか現地でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The rest symbol is here. Seats and surrounding space are not guaranteed; check on site whether you can park without blocking the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 置く所がなければ無理にその場所へ留まりません。帰りは一周の矢印ではなく、来た道を逆にたどると図へ書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 置場がなければ滞留せず、一周矢印でなく来た道を逆に戻る線を図へ頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there is no place for it, I will not insist on remaining there. Could you draw the return along the way I came, rather than following the circuit arrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not remain where there is no cart space, and ask for a line retracing the outward route rather than the circuit arrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 往復する線を別の色で記しました。分かれ道で一周の矢印へ進まないよう、現在地と戻る入口も印を付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I marked the out-and-back in another color, along with your current location and return entrance so you do not follow the circuit arrow at a fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この色の線で入口へ戻ります。行きの道だけを見ず、帰りも含めた道で選び、今日は短い往復にして荷物ごと帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 色の線で元の入口へ戻り、往路だけでなく帰路も見て短い往復を選ぶと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return to the entrance along this colored line. I will choose based on the return route too, not only the outward one, and make a short out-and-back with my luggage today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will follow the colored line back to the original entrance, checking both directions and choosing a short out-and-back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図はこちらです。池や一周を目標にせず、その場の道と混み具合を見てお決めください。カートと周りに気を配り、どうぞよいお散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the map. Do not make the pond or circuit a fixed goal; decide by the actual path and crowding. Watch the cart and people around you, and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行案内の表示が更新されました。どの点を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The service information display has been updated. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画像に二十分遅れとあったので、二十分待てば必ず発車すると思いました。そういう意味ではないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二十分遅れを二十分後の確実な発車と受け取ったが違うのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The image said a twenty-minute delay, so I thought it would definitely depart after I waited twenty minutes. Is that not what it means?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether interpreting a twenty-minute delay as definite departure twenty minutes later is incorrect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発車まであと二十分という確約ではありません。その画像の情報は、いつのものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is not a promise of departure in twenty minutes. When is the information in that image from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝九時に保存しました。今は九時半なので、保存してから三十分たっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存は九時で今は九時半、三十分前の情報だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saved it at nine this morning. It is nine thirty now, so thirty minutes have passed since I saved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the image was saved at nine and it is now nine thirty, making the information thirty minutes old. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の案内では、発車時刻はまだ未定です。到着を待っている方へ、状況を連絡する必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The current information says the departure time is still undecided. Do you need to contact someone waiting for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場の集合に遅れるかもしれません。到着時刻を決めて伝えず、発車が未定だと連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場の集合に遅れる可能性を伝え、確定時刻でなく発車未定と連絡したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I may be late for the gathering at work. I want to say departure is undecided, rather than give a fixed arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you might be late for a workplace gathering and want to report undecided departure rather than a definite time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのようにお伝えください。待つ間は、屋内の案内表示で更新を確認できます。場所はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain it that way. While waiting, you can check updates on the indoor information display. Do you know where it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口の小さな掲示だけ見ていました。屋内の表示の場所と、座って待てる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口の掲示しか見ていないと伝え、屋内の更新表示と待合席の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was only looking at the small notice by the entrance. Please show me the indoor display and somewhere to sit while waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you only saw the entrance notice and ask for the indoor update display and waiting seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正面の案内表示と、その横の待合席をご利用ください。席を離れていた場合は、戻ってから最新の案内を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Use the display straight ahead and the waiting seats beside it. If you leave your seat, check the latest information when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に職場へ連絡し、待合席で待ちます。古い画像は使わず、戻るたびに正面の表示か窓口で現在の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職場に連絡して待合席で待ち、古い画像でなく現在の表示か窓口で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact work first and wait in the seating area. I will not use the old image; whenever I return, I will check the current situation on the display ahead or at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will contact work and wait seated, using the current display or counter rather than the old image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発車が決まったという案内を確認するまでは、遅れの数字だけで乗り場へ急がず、更新をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Until you see confirmation of departure, do not rush to the boarding area based only on the delay number; please await updates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約についてですね。予約済みの相談内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: About your reservation: what consultation have you booked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私宛ての通知を相談する予約です。同居人も別の通知を受け取ったので、同じ予約で二人分を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の予約に同居人の別通知の相談も入れられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is about a notice addressed to me. My housemate received another notice; can we consult about both under the same reservation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your reservation can include your housemate's separate notice consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別件が増える場合は、担当と時間の確認が必要です。同居人の方は、日本語の補助として同行するのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Adding another matter requires checking the department and time. Is your housemate accompanying you to help with Japanese?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本語も手伝ってくれますが、本人の通知についても質問したいそうです。私の用件とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居人は日本語補助もするが本人の別件もあると区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They will also help with Japanese, but want to ask about their own notice too. That is separate from my matter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your housemate's Japanese assistance from their own separate consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、同行者として来ることと、別の相談を申し込むことを分けましょう。通知を出した担当はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish coming as a companion from applying for a separate consultation. Do you know which department issued their notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ通知を見せてもらっていません。本人に差出し担当と相談したい内容を確認してから、追加の予約方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知は未確認なので本人に担当と相談内容を聞いてから追加予約を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not seen it yet. I want to ask them the sending department and what they want to discuss, then ask how to make an additional reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked the notice and will ask them its department and consultation topic before asking about an extra booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容がわかれば担当先を確認できます。同居人の方が来られる日時も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once that is known, we can check the appropriate department. Can you also check when your housemate can attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私と同じ日に休めるか、まだわかりません。私の予約を勝手に変えず、本人の都合を聞いてから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居人の休みが不明で、自分の予約は変えず本人の都合を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not yet know whether they can take the same day off. I will not change my reservation on my own; I will ask their availability and then contact you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your housemate's day off is unknown and you will keep your booking while checking their availability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。今のご予約はそのままにして、別件についてはあらためてお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Keep your current reservation and inquire again about the other matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の通知は今の予約で相談し、同居人の件は本人の希望と担当先がわかってから申し込みます。同行だけの場合の扱いも、そのとき確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分は既存予約で相談し、別件は本人希望と担当を確認後に申し込み、同行だけの扱いも聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult about my notice under the existing booking, and apply for my housemate's matter after learning their wishes and department. I will also check then how it works if they only accompany me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use your existing booking, apply for the separate matter after checking their wishes and department, and ask about accompanying only too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、二つの用件を区別してご連絡ください。今日は既存の予約を変更せずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, contact us distinguishing the two matters. We will leave the existing reservation unchanged today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計はお済みですね。書類についてどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have finished payment. What would you like to ask about documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場の用紙に「復職予定日」とあります。今日の領収書の受診日を、ここへ写してもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 復職予定日欄へ領収書の受診日を写してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace form says 'Planned return-to-work date.' May I copy today's visit date from the receipt into that field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may copy the receipt's visit date into the planned return-to-work field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書の日付は受診や支払いに関する日付で、仕事に戻れるという判断を示すものではありません。医師から復職日のお話はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: A receipt date concerns the visit or payment; it does not indicate a judgment that you can return to work. Did your doctor discuss a return date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日付の話はしていません。職場から早く戻ってほしいと言われたので、私が今日と書こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 医師から日付の話はなく、職場に急がされ自分で今日と書こうとしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: We did not discuss a date. Work asked me to return soon, so I was about to write today myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the doctor did not discuss a date, and workplace pressure led you to consider writing today yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会計窓口では復職日を判断して記入できません。職場が求める内容を確認し、その用紙を医師に相談する方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The billing counter cannot decide or enter a return-to-work date. We will check what your workplace requires and explain how to consult your doctor about that form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この用紙を医師に相談するための窓口を教えてください。受付に出せば今日中に完成する、と考えないほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用紙を医師に相談する窓口を尋ね、今日中に完成するとは限らないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please tell me the counter for consulting the doctor about this form. Should I not assume that submitting it at reception means it will be completed today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to consult the doctor about the form and confirm that completion today is not guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日中の完成はお約束できません。内容を確認して、相談や申請の方法、費用と受取時期を担当からご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot promise completion today. After checking the contents, the staff will explain consultation or application methods, cost, and collection timing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今日受け取れると職場には言いません。必要な記載内容を職場に聞き、用紙は記入せずに相談へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場へ本日受取りとは言わず、必要記載を確認し未記入の用紙で相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not tell work I can receive it today. I will ask work what needs to be written and bring the blank form to the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not promise today's collection to work, will check required entries, and consult with the unfilled form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。領収書は書類の申請とは別に、お手元で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. Keep the receipt yourself separately from the document application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書は保管し、この用紙と分けます。職場への確認事項と、医師に相談したい復職日のことを別々にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書と用紙を分け、職場への質問と医師への復職日相談を別々にメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the receipt apart from this form. I will make separate notes of questions for work and the return date I want to discuss with the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate receipt and form and make separate notes for workplace questions and the doctor's return-to-work consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、書類の相談担当へおつなぎします。今日の領収書と職場の用紙を混同せず、未確認の日付はそのままお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to the document consultation staff. Do not confuse today's receipt with the workplace form, and explain plainly that the date is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物について伺います。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ask about your lost item. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 眼鏡と青いケースです。二つ一緒になくしたと思って来ましたが、今、友人からケースだけあったと連絡が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眼鏡とケースを一緒になくしたと思ったが、友人からケースだけ発見の連絡が来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My glasses and a blue case. I came thinking I lost both together, but my friend just contacted me saying only the case was found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought glasses and case were lost together, but your friend reported finding only the case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ケースの中に眼鏡は入っていなかったのですね。眼鏡を最後に使った場面は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the glasses were not in the case. Do you remember the last time you used them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夜、家で本を読んだときです。今朝はケースに入っていると思っただけで、中は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の使用は昨夜自宅での読書で、今朝はケース内を見ず入っていると思っただけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last night, reading at home. This morning I only assumed they were in the case; I did not look inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you last used them reading at home last night, and this morning merely assumed they were inside without checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、ケースの発見場所で眼鏡もなくしたとは、まだ決められません。友人はケースをどこで見つけたと言っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we cannot yet conclude the glasses were also lost where the case was found. Where did your friend say they found the case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日一緒に行った喫茶店の椅子です。でも、眼鏡がそこにあったのを私は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースは喫茶店の椅子で発見されたが、眼鏡自体はそこで見ていないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On a chair at the cafe we visited together today. But I did not see the glasses themselves there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish finding the case on a cafe chair from not seeing the glasses themselves there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いを記録します。眼鏡自体の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that distinction. Please describe the glasses themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 細い茶色の枠です。右側のつるの内側に小さな白い印があります。ケースは見つかった物として、眼鏡だけまだ不明と伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 茶色の細い枠と右つる内側の白印を説明し、ケースのみ発見済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thin brown frames. There is a small white mark inside the right temple. I want to report the case as found and only the glasses as still missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe thin brown frames and a white mark inside the right temple, and say only the case has been found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。届出の内容をまとめます。ご連絡先と記載内容をご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will organize the report. Could you check the entries and your contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認したいのですが、眼鏡がなくて小さい字が読みにくいです。記入した内容を読み上げてもらってから、連絡先を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 眼鏡なしでは小さい字を読みにくいため、内容を読み上げてもらい連絡先を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to, but without my glasses small print is difficult. Could you read the entries aloud first so I can check my contact details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that small print is difficult without glasses and request the entries be read aloud before checking contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、内容を読み上げます。ケースの発見と眼鏡の所在不明を分けて確認し、最後に連絡先も一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I will read them. Let us distinguish the found case from the still-missing glasses, then check the contact details together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。どこが読めなくなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery slip. Which part is unreadable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号の最後がにじんでいて、三か八かわかりません。両方で再配達を申し込んでみればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票番号の末尾が三か八か読めず、両方で再配達依頼してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The last digit is smudged; I cannot tell whether it is three or eight. Should I try requesting redelivery with both numbers?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot read whether the last digit is three or eight and ask whether to request redelivery with both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 違う番号を推測して依頼せず、まず確認しましょう。票に宛名や差出人は読める部分がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not guess different numbers to request delivery; let us check first. Are the addressee or sender readable on the slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名は私の名前です。差出人は家族の名前だと読めますが、番号の最後と保管期限の一部は読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名と差出家族名は読めるが、番号末尾と期限一部は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The addressee is my name. I can read a family member's name as sender, but not the last number digit or part of the storage deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your name and family sender's name are readable but the last digit and part of the deadline are unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読める情報を拝見します。ご家族に、発送時の控えを確認してもらえますか。受取方法は確認できてから選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see the readable information. Can your family check their dispatch receipt? Choose the collection method after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に控えの写真を頼みます。番号が確認できるまで、今日の夜に届くとは考えないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ発送控えの写真を頼み、番号未確認で今夜の配達を予定できないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my family for a photo of their receipt. Until the number is confirmed, I should not expect delivery tonight, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask for a dispatch-receipt photo and confirm that tonight's delivery cannot be planned with the number unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、まだ再配達の受付もしていません。写真が届いたら、この票と照合して、期限や選べる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct, we have not even accepted a redelivery request yet. Once the photo arrives, we will compare it with this slip and check the deadline and available methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓口で受け取る案も考えています。この票を見せれば、今ここに荷物があるかどうかも調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口受取も考え、票を示して今この窓口に荷物があるか調べてもらいたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am also considering counter collection. Can you use this slip to check whether the parcel is at this counter now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are considering counter collection and ask them to use the slip to check whether the parcel is currently at this counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管場所も含めて確認します。この窓口にあるとはまだ言えませんので、受取りに必要な物も確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the storage location too. We cannot yet say it is here, so we will explain what to bring for collection after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、今日は荷物を受け取れると決めず、読める宛名と家族の控えをそろえて相談します。期限も推測せず確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の受取りは確定せず、宛名と家族控えをそろえ、期限も推測せず確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will not assume I can collect today; I will consult with the readable addressee and my family's receipt. Please also check the deadline without guessing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say today's collection is unconfirmed, you will prepare the addressee and family receipt, and ask to verify rather than guess the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。不在票は捨てずにお持ちください。番号、期限、保管場所を確認してから、受取方法を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Keep the missed-delivery slip. Let us confirm the number, deadline, and storage location before deciding how to receive it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失でしょうか。どのカードが見当たらないか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you lost a card? Please tell me which card is missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カード入れごとなくしました。こちらの銀行と、別の銀行のカードが一枚ずつあります。ここで両方を止められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード入れごと失い二行のカードが一枚ずつあり、一括停止できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost the whole card holder. It contains one card from this bank and one from another bank. Can you stop both here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your card holder is lost with one card from each of two banks, and ask whether both can be blocked together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行のカードについて確認します。他の銀行の停止まで、この窓口で済むとはお約束できません。それぞれの発行元を区別しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check our bank's card. We cannot promise this counter can also complete the other bank's block. Let us distinguish each issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、こちらの銀行のカードから相談します。二枚の番号を覚えていなくても、手元の通帳などで確認を進められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当行カードから相談し、番号不明でも通帳等で確認を進められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will start with this bank's card. Even without remembering either card number, can we proceed with checking using my passbook and similar documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Start with this bank's card and ask whether checks can proceed using a passbook despite unknown card numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる資料を拝見し、所定の本人確認をご案内します。暗証番号を口頭でお伝えいただく必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will see the available documents and explain the required identity verification. You do not need to tell us your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 暗証番号は言いません。こちらの通帳を見せます。カード入れを最後に確認したのは、今日の朝、自宅を出る前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗証番号は言わず通帳を示し、最後の確認は今朝外出前と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not say my PIN. Here is my passbook. I last confirmed the holder this morning before leaving home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not disclose your PIN; show the passbook and say the last check was this morning before going out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況も伺います。利用停止と再発行は、分けて手続きを確認しましょう。再発行まで今ここで決めたいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will note that too. Let us check blocking and replacement separately. Do you want to decide about replacement here now as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず停止の手続きを進めたいです。再発行は必要な書類、費用、受取時期を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まず停止手続きを希望し、再発行は書類・費用・時期を聞いてから決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I want to proceed with blocking. I want to decide on replacement after hearing the required documents, cost, and collection timing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request blocking first and say you will decide on replacement after hearing documents, cost, and timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。停止の手続きがどこまで済んだかもご説明します。別の銀行への連絡は、当行の説明とは分けて控えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will explain how far blocking has progressed too. Record contacting the other bank separately from our explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらの停止状況を確かめて控え、もう一枚は別の発行元へ連絡します。二枚とも止まったとは、確認前に家族へ言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当行の停止状況を控え、別行へも連絡し、両方停止済みとは未確認で伝えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm and note this bank's block status and contact the other issuer about the second card. I will not tell my family both are blocked before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record this bank's status, contact the other bank, and not say both are blocked without confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、当行分の本人確認から進めます。別の発行元への相談が残ることと、当行分の手続き状況を分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us start identity verification for our bank's card. Distinguish the outstanding consultation with the other issuer from our procedure's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 日用品についてのご相談ですね。商品はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a household product. Do you have it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った洗濯ネットです。一度使ったら口が開いていました。まだ一回なので、最初から壊れていたと思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日買ったネットが一度の使用で開き、初期不良と思ったと現物を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This laundry net I bought yesterday. After one use it was open. Since it was only once, I thought it had been broken from the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show yesterday's laundry net that opened after one use and say you thought it was initially defective. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使用前からの状態かどうかは、まだ確認が必要です。使う前に、ファスナーを閉めたところは見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether that condition existed before use still needs checking. Did you see the zipper closed before using it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉めたつもりですが、最後まで動かしたかは覚えていません。中には薄いシャツを一枚入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉めたつもりだが最後まで動かしたか不明で、薄いシャツ一枚を入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I closed it, but do not remember moving it all the way. I put one thin shirt inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought you closed it but are unsure it moved fully, and put one thin shirt inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その内容を記録します。現物のファスナーの状態を確認してよいですか。何かご自身で直しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record that. May I check the actual zipper? Did you repair anything yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直していません。無理に引っ張らず、そのまま持ってきました。レシートはありますが、外側の袋は捨ててしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分では直さずそのまま持参し、レシートはあるが外袋は処分したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I brought it as it was without pulling hard. I have the receipt, but threw away the outer bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not repair it and brought it unchanged, have a receipt but discarded the outer bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: レシートと現物を拝見します。売場の見本と形も比べて確認しますが、その前に交換できると確定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will see the receipt and item, and compare the shape with the display sample. Before that check, an exchange cannot be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず状態を見てください。見本には持ち手を収める部分があった気がするので、この商品にもあるか教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先に現物を見てもらい、見本にあった持ち手を収める部分が商品にもあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please look at its condition first. I think the sample had a place to tuck the zipper pull; could you tell me whether this product does too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to inspect the item first and whether it also has the sample's place for tucking the zipper pull. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本と同じ型で、こちらにも持ち手を収める部分があります。ただ、使用中に開いた原因は、担当者による現物の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is the same model as the sample and has a place to tuck the pull here too. However, staff need to inspect the actual item to determine why it opened during use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 収める部分はあるのですね。使い方だけでなく、部品の状態も確認してほしいです。その説明を聞いてから、交換など可能な対応を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち手を収める部分はあると確認し、部品の状態も確認後に可能な交換等を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: So it does have that place. I want not only the usage checked but the parts' condition too. After hearing the explanation, I will ask about possible responses such as exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm it has a place to tuck the pull and say you will consult about possible exchange and other responses after the parts' condition is checked too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当者と一緒に現物を確認します。今は原因や交換の可否を決めず、確認できた内容から順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the item with the responsible staff. For now we will not determine the cause or exchange eligibility, but explain what is confirmed in order.
